thread:
anna: Quick heads-up — I opened a docs PR to add a short Export + Consent guide (Node + Rails snippets) and a manifest example for legal-hold workflows. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1034

docs-bot: PR opened by anna — https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1034 (labels: docs, compliance)

ruben: Legal: please define 'sensitive customer data' (SCD) in the section and require 'consent.document_url' + 'consent.signed_by' in examples for any legal/export flows. Also add a one-line acceptance path: "Submit authorization via support with the attached signed document or a counsel-signed ticket."

anna: added SCD definition and a placeholder for consent fields. Thanks — question for SDK folks: the Node SDK currently exposes `mask_keys`, Rails exposes `redact_fields`. What should docs show as the canonical param name?

maya: SDK: back-end canonical field is `export_scrub` in JSON jobs. My suggestion: show canonical HTTP example using `export_scrub`, then include short SDK samples that use the SDK names with an alias note. Add inline comment: "# server-side consent validation pending (INF-6230)" so customers don't assume immediate enforcement.

liam: infra note: INF-6230 opened to accept `consent.document_url` and `legal_hold_ref` in exports jobs — ETA ~3 business days. Recommend marking PR as Preview/Draft and adding an "Implementation status" banner linking the ticket.

kevin: ops: please add a manifest example that surfaces `redaction_status` (values: queued/processing/done/failed), `legal_hold_ref`, and `consent` metadata so support teams know what to check.

anna: added banner and manifest example. Pasting the compact manifest & SDK samples below so we can nudge wording quickly. Feedback welcome.

anna: ```json
// export manifest (example)
{
  "export_id": "exp_20241201_007",
  "requested_by": "zoe@acme.com",
  "legal_hold_ref": "LH-77",
  "redaction_status": "queued",
  "artifact_url": "s3://exports/exp_20241201_007.jsonl",
  "consent": {"document_url": "https://acme.com/auth.pdf", "signed_by": "legal@acme.com"}
}
```

maya: ```js
// node snippet (SDK aliasing)
// Note: server-side consent validation pending (INF-6230)
const client = require('@redwood/sdk')
await client.exports.create({
  scope: 'tenant',
  mask_keys: ['email','username']
})
```

maya: ```rb
# rails snippet (SDK uses `redact_fields`)
# Note: server-side consent validation pending (INF-6230)
client.exports.create(
  scope: 'tenant',
  redact_fields: ['email','username']
)
```

ruben: wording looks fine. One legal tweak: add the sentence: "Exports for regulatory or litigation purposes require written authorization from an authorized company representative; Redwood will validate metadata before processing." Also include the support intake path.

anna: added the sentence and support intake instructions. I'll squash commits and keep the PR as Preview until INF-6230 is linked. Thanks all — I'll request review after infra updates the ticket.

docs-bot: anna updated PR #1034 — now marked Preview (labels: preview, compliance)

kevin: :+1: leaving final review for after INF-6230 is resolved.
